method: Counters are deltas of exact per-stream keys; muted streams are excluded. NonzeroVoice means decoded packet peak > 0, including microphone noise; it is not a perceptual voice gate. Counter units are affected packets, possibly partly cut, not audible intervals or missing duration.
historicalConclusion: The +1445 belongs to laptop's unmuted direct host peer b3fa1990ed540274e974103b79e33558, not the muted server mix. All 13 saved snapshots show mute=0/gain=1; nonzero cut delta is also 1445. No sender real-mic reference or packet trace exists for that historical take, so audible-versus-noise and durations cannot be retrospectively established from these counters.
